# Manish Tea Traders

> Wholesale tea supplier based in Siliguri, West Bengal, since 2004. GST-registered, Tea Board of India-recognised (KOL/B-7410). Supplies CTC, Darjeeling, Assam, and Nepal tea in bulk to retailers, distributors, hotels, and private label brands across India.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.manishteatraders.in/): Overview, product range, and company details.
- [Request Free Samples](https://www.manishteatraders.in/request-free-tea-samples/): Free B2B tea sample requests, dispatched within 48 hours.
- [Private Label Tea Packaging](https://www.manishteatraders.in/services/private-label-tea/): Custom-branded tea packaging service, low MOQ.
- [Tea Blend Calculator](https://www.manishteatraders.in/tea-blend-calculator/): Free tool to calculate blend cost and profit margin.
- [Tea Grades Guide](https://www.manishteatraders.in/tea-grades/): Quick reference for CTC and orthodox tea grades.
